description: Returns the attributes of an object structure saved in the work screen: a summary of key columns and child objects, and the attributes (name, label, type, length, required). Structures can have hundreds of columns, so narrow the result with query (part of a name or label, e.g. PERMIT or TAGNO), child or columns.

child.description: Return only the attributes of this child object

columns.description: Return only these columns (children as EXT_WOPERMIT.EXT_PERMITDATE)

query.description: Substring of the attribute name or label (case-insensitive; full-width and half-width characters match)

name: describe_object_structure
title: Describe an object structure
